about_pullquote: Every tree tells a story. We keep them safe and healthy for generations.
about_para_1: Green Man Tree Care was founded on the principle that great arboriculture starts with genuine care for trees and the people who live beneath them. With over 15 years of hands-on experience across Sheffield and South Yorkshire, we've handled everything from routine pruning on 50-year-old oaks to emergency removals after severe storms. We're committed to leaving every garden safer, healthier, and more beautiful.
about_para_2: We're not tree cowboys; we understand the biology, the risks, and the legal side of arboricultural work. Every job is planned carefully, executed safely, and cleaned up properly. Our customers return because they know we'll never oversell unnecessary work—if a mature tree can be saved with good pruning, we'll say so. That honesty and craftsmanship is why Sheffield homeowners and businesses trust us with their gardens.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Green Man

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree that was dropping branches all over the garden. Green Man came out, assessed it properly, and pruned it brilliantly. The difference is night and day—safer now and the tree looks healthier. Fair price too, and no faffing about.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Storm brought down two big branches onto our fence last February. Called Green Man early morning and they were here by midday. Cleared everything, made the tree safe, and fixed the fence damage too. Professional outfit, would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret K.

reviews.text: Got a quote from another firm to remove an old ash tree, then called Green Man for a second opinion. They explained why the tree was still worth saving with careful pruning, and did a stunning job for half the price. That's the kind of honesty you need.
reviews.author: Paul M.
